# WeSchool visual assets

Official logo, used without changing its artwork:
https://www.welingkar.org/sites/all/themes/welingkar/images/logo_25.svg

Mumbai campus photograph, labelled "Mumbai - WeSchool Campus" on the official homepage:
https://www.welingkar.org/sites/all/themes/welingkar/images/home/Mumbai-home-campus.jpeg

Both are sourced from https://www.welingkar.org/. This website is a placement-team concept demo, not the institute's official website. No rankings, placement statistics or recruiter endorsements have been added.

The header logo was supplied by the user as `/Users/tanmay/Desktop/logo_25.svg` on 4 November 2026 and copied unchanged to `weschool-logo.svg`. The screenshot Voiceagent.png is a visual reference only; it is not embedded as the interface.
